# Invoicely

> Invoicely is a free online invoice generator. Fill in a form, see a live preview, and download a clean PDF invoice. No sign-up, no watermark. Invoice data stays in the user's browser.

## Key pages
- [Free Invoice Generator](https://yourdomain.com/): create and download an invoice as PDF
- [Freelance Invoice Generator](https://yourdomain.com/freelance-invoice-generator): invoices for freelancers and contractors
- [Invoice Generator for Nigeria](https://yourdomain.com/invoice-generator-nigeria): Naira invoices with VAT (7.5%) support
- [Receipt Generator](https://yourdomain.com/receipt-generator): simple payment receipts
- [How to Write an Invoice](https://yourdomain.com/how-to-write-an-invoice): step-by-step guide with a checklist

## Facts
- Price: free, no account required
- Currencies: NGN, USD, GBP, EUR, GHS, KES, ZAR, CAD, AUD, INR
- Output: PDF via the browser print dialog
- Privacy: invoices are never uploaded; they are stored only in the user's browser
